title: input_schema
description: Required input contract for the ImmuKnow notice pipeline.

fields.name: school_name
fields.description: School name, optionally followed by a facility ID in the format 'SCHOOL NAME - FACILITY ID'

fields.name: overdue_disease
fields.description: Semicolon-separated overdue diseases. Each disease may be followed by ' - N', where N is the next dose number as a positive whole number, for example 'Measles - 2; Polio;'. A dose suffix that is not a positive whole number produces a warning, and the disease is shown without a number. Whether dose numbers appear on notices is set by include-dose in Settings.

fields.name: overdue_agent
fields.description: Semicolon-separated list of overdue agents for client

fields.name: imms_given
fields.description: Semicolon-separated entries in the exact form 'YYYY-MM-DD - Agent', optionally followed by ' - Valid' or ' - Invalid', for example '2020-05-01 - MMR - Valid;'. Month and day always have two digits. Dates must exist. Every entry ends with ';', including the last. Spaces, tabs and line breaks may surround entries; field separators are exactly space-hyphen-space. Blank history and the placeholders '-;' and '-  -;' (when validity is exported) mean no history. A missing final ';', a leading ';', ';;' and other empty entries, extra fields and wrongly cased status tokens reject the whole input file.
